name: Belantamab Mafodotin (BCMA antibody-drug conjugate)

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Belantamab mafodotin is a BCMA-directed antibody-drug conjugate for triple-class-exposed relapsed/refractory myeloma; BCMA is near-universally expressed, so use is not by a selective biomarker. Physician decides.

premedications.name: Corticosteroid eye drops
premedications.notes: Preservative-free corticosteroid drops per ocular-toxicity program, started with each dose per labeling; use lubricating drops as directed.

supportiveCare: Mandatory ophthalmology assessment at baseline and before each dose; dose-modify or delay for keratopathy (corneal exam findings) and visual-acuity change.
Counsel on ocular symptoms (dry eye, blurred vision); avoid contact lenses unless advised.
Infusion-reaction monitoring on the first doses.
Often combined with pomalidomide or bortezomib as a partner (separate agents).
monitoring: ophthalmic examination (keratopathy and best-corrected visual acuity) before each dose
CBC with differential and platelets before each cycle

doseModificationRules.condition: moderate to severe keratopathy or visual-acuity decline
doseModificationRules.text: Hold belantamab mafodotin until corneal findings and visual acuity recover, then resume at the same or a reduced dose per the ocular-toxicity program; permanently discontinue for the most severe ocular events. Ophthalmology directs.

drugs.name: Belantamab Mafodotin
drugs.notes: Belantamab mafodotin 2.5 mg/kg IV on day 1 of each 21-day cycle (single-agent monotherapy dosing), continued until progression or unacceptable ocular/other toxicity. Dosing is by actual body weight. Mandatory pre-dose ophthalmology; hold/reduce for keratopathy per the ocular-risk program. Own wording from standard-of-care knowledge; physician decides.

provenance.locator: belantamab mafodotin BCMA ADC, relapsed/refractory myeloma monotherapy dosing
